---
title: "R code to generate Change from baseline across PRO domains (figure)" ######change
output: html_document
params:
    continuous_data: NA
    no_doseG: NA
    func_G: NA
    final_tG: NA
    continuous_date: NA
    title: NA
    titlesize: NA
    axissize: 30
    subtitle: "PRO domain"
    y_lab: "Mean change from baseline to timepoint (with 95% CI) \n for PRO domain"
    improveG: "Improvement"
    worseG: "Worsening"
    impTextG: 17 
    worTextG: -17 
---

```{r}
print(params[-1])

## To install the required packages, uncomment the following lines and run the code
# install.packages("ggplot2", "DT", "magrittr", "dplyr", "ggsurvfit", "ggh4x", "tidyr", "gt", "gridExtra", "survminer")
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)
library(magrittr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggsurvfit)
library(ggh4x)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)
library(gridExtra)
library(survminer)

# Define parameters
continuous_data <- params$continuous_data
no_doseG <- params$no_doseG
func_G <- params$func_G
final_tG <- params$final_tG
continuous_date <- params$continuous_date

# Function to handle date data
date_to_timepoint_continuous <- function(data) {
    data %>%
        group_by(id, functioning) %>%
        arrange(timepoint) %>%
        mutate(date = timepoint, timepoint = row_number() - 1) %>%
        ungroup()
}

# Filter data to get relevant doses and timepoint
no_patientG <- continuous_data %>%
    filter(dose %in% no_doseG) %>%
    filter(timepoint == min(timepoint), functioning == func_G[1]) %>%
    count(dose)


continuous_data_filteredG <- continuous_data

# Logic to handle date format
if (continuous_date == TRUE) {
    # continuous_data_filteredG$timepoint <- as.Date(continuous_data_filteredG$timepoint)
    continuous_data_filteredG <- date_to_timepoint_continuous(continuous_data_filteredG) %>% select(-date)
}

# Logic to handle PRO domain format
continuous_data_filteredG$functioning <- as.character(continuous_data_filteredG$functioning)

# Filter the data to relevant dose and PRO domain
continuous_data_filteredG <- continuous_data_filteredG %>%
    filter(dose %in% no_doseG) %>%
    filter(functioning %in% func_G)

# Create a data frame with the number of missing patients at each timepoint
ice_n_pat <- continuous_data_filteredG %>%
    group_by(dose, id) %>%
    summarise(n_timepoints = n_distinct(timepoint), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(dose) %>%
    mutate(max_timepoints = final_tG) %>%
    filter(n_timepoints < max_timepoints) %>%
    summarise(n_patients_missing = n_distinct(id))

# Find first and last timepoints
endT_list <- unique(continuous_data_filteredG %>% filter(timepoint <= final_tG) %>% select(timepoint))
endT <- max(endT_list$timepoint)
startT <- min(unique(continuous_data_filteredG$timepoint))
tp_end <- sym(paste0("tp_", endT))
tp_start <- sym(paste0("tp_", startT))

# Create a data frame with the change from baseline to the final timepoint
dfG <- continuous_data_filteredG %>%
    filter(timepoint <= endT) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = score, names_prefix = "tp_", id_cols = c(id, dose, functioning)) %>%
    mutate(score = !!tp_end - !!tp_start) %>%
    dplyr::select(id, score, dose, functioning)

# Add columns containing the number of unreported and reported patients
dfG <- dfG %>%
    group_by(dose, functioning) %>%
    mutate(non_na_count = sum(!is.na(score))) %>%
    mutate(na_count = sum(is.na(score))) %>%
    ungroup()

# Create a data frame containing only the number of unreported patients for each dose and PRO domain
unrep <- dfG %>%
    group_by(dose, functioning) %>%
    distinct(na_count) %>%
    ungroup()

# Create a summary data frame with the mean change from baseline, standard error, and 95% confidence intervals for each dose and PRO domain
sum.dfG <- dfG %>%
    group_by(dose, functioning) %>%
    summarise(
        mean = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE), non_na_count = unique(non_na_count),
        se = sd(score, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(non_na_count), .groups = "keep"
    )

sum.dfG <- sum.dfG %>% mutate(l.ci = mean - (1.96 * se))
sum.dfG <- sum.dfG %>% mutate(u.ci = mean + (1.96 * se))
sum.dfG <- sum.dfG %>%
    left_join(unrep, by = c("dose", "functioning")) %>%
    mutate(custom_x = paste0("Dose=", dose, "\nUR=", na_count))
sum.dfG$functioning <- as.factor(sum.dfG$functioning)


first_fn <- as.symbol(as.character((sum.dfG$functioning[1])))

# Code to set up arrow, improvement and worsening bounds and labels
arrowdf <- tibble(functioning = as.factor(as.character(first_fn)))

formatterG <- function(functioning = unique(sum.dfG$functioning), subtitle = params$subtitle) {
    paste(subtitle, functioning, sep = " ")
}
formatterG()

impbound <- params$improveG
worbound <- params$worseG

minval <- min(dfG$score, na.rm = TRUE)
maxval <- max(dfG$score, na.rm = TRUE)

upper <- max(worbound[2], impbound[2], maxval)
lower <- min(worbound[1], impbound[1], minval)

worse_text <- if (worbound[1] < impbound[1]) {
    min(max(params$worTextG, worbound[1]), worbound[2])
} else {
    max(min(params$worTextG, worbound[2]), worbound[1])
}

improve_text <- if (worbound[1] < impbound[1]) {
    max(min(params$impTextG, impbound[2]), impbound[1])
} else {
    min(max(params$impTextG, impbound[1]), impbound[2])
}

thresholds <- data.frame(
    ymin = c(impbound[1], worbound[1]),
    ymax = c(impbound[2], worbound[2]),
    Threshold = factor(c("Improvement", "Worsening"))
)

# Create a data frame with the number of patients for each dose then create label to be used in the x-axis of the plot
no_patient <- unlist(no_patientG[2])
no_patient <- paste(no_patient, collapse = ";")

# Generate the plot
data.frame(sum.dfG) %>% ggplot(aes(x = custom_x, y = mean, colour = as.factor(dose))) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    scale_color_discrete(name = "Dose") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = l.ci, ymax = u.ci), width = 0.2, size = 1.2) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    ylim(c(lower, upper)) +
    scale_fill_manual(
        name = "Threshold",
        values = c("Improvement" = "palegreen1", "Worsening" = "red")
    ) +
    geom_rect(
        data = thresholds,
        aes(xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = Threshold),
        alpha = 0.3, inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(
        y = paste0(params$y_lab),
        x = paste0("Dose (N= ", no_patient, ")")
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ as.factor(functioning), nrow = 1, labeller = as_labeller(formatterG), scales = "free_x") +
    scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(1, 1))) +
    geom_segment(
        data = arrowdf,
        aes(x = 0.5, xend = 0.5, y = 0, yend = upper),
        colour = "darkgrey", size = 0.8, arrow = arrow(
            type = "closed",
            length = unit(0.1, "inches")
        )
    ) +
    geom_segment(
        data = arrowdf,
        aes(x = 0.5, xend = 0.5, y = 0, yend = lower),
        colour = "darkgrey", size = 0.8, arrow = arrow(
            type = "closed",
            length = unit(0.1, "inches")
        )
    ) +
    geom_text(
        data = arrowdf, aes(x = 1, y = improve_text, label = "Improvement"),
        inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
        data = arrowdf, aes(x = 1, y = worse_text, label = "Worsening"),
        inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    ggtitle(params$title) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = params$titlesize, face = "bold"), axis.title = element_text(size = params$axissize))
```
